name: Hill Inlet Lookout
note: Viewpoint: three lookout platforms up a short rainforest climb on Whitsunday Island over Hill Inlet's turquoise water and silica sand.

name: Heart Reef
note: Reef: heart-shaped reef formation on the Great Barrier Reef, seen from scenic flights and reef tours.

name: Camp Island
note: Island: Whitsunday island listed by Tourism Whitsundays among its island destinations; visitor access details not read.

name: Langford Island
note: Island: Whitsunday island visited on day sails, named by Tourism Whitsundays as a stunning island paradise.

name: Passage Peak
note: Hike: steep Hamilton Island circuit to a rocky summit with wide views (Hamilton Island Loop, also called Passage Peak).

name: Mount Jeffreys Walk
note: Hike: out-and-back from Sandy Bay on Hamilton Island to Mount Jeffreys, a shared trail with mountain bikers.

name: Catseye Beach to Escape Beach Walk
note: Hike: easy island walk across headlands from Catseye Beach to Escape Beach on Hamilton Island.

name: Hamilton Island Resort Lookout
note: Viewpoint: short climb from Catseye Beach to a rocky lookout over the Whitsundays on Hamilton Island.

name: Blue Pearl Bay
note: Beach: snorkelling bay on Hayman Island reached by a steep rainforest walk from the Hayman Loop.

name: Lovers Cove
note: Beach: quiet coral cove on Daydream Island's western side with snorkelling straight off the shore.

name: Chalkies Beach
note: Beach: snorkelling stop beside Whitehaven Beach on day sails, named by Tourism Whitsundays.

name: Airlie Beach
note: Town: the Whitsundays' mainland base, with a marina, lagoon, boardwalk and jumping-off point for island tours.

name: Airlie Beach Lagoon
note: Beach: man-made swimming lagoon at Airlie Beach, the start of the Bicentennial Walkway.

name: Honeyeater Lookout
note: Viewpoint: challenging out-and-back climb from Kara Crescent in Airlie Beach to wide views over the Whitsundays.

name: Bicentennial Walkway
note: Walk: coastal path linking Airlie Beach Lagoon to Cannonvale Beach past marina and bay views.

name: Cedar Creek Falls
note: Waterfall: rock swimming hole in rainforest in Conway National Park, free entry, sealed road access; flow depends on rain.

name: Conway National Park
note: National park: rainforest walks, coastal lookouts and waterfall swimming between Airlie Beach and Proserpine.

name: Conway Circuit
note: Hike: long rainforest route through Conway National Park from the hinterland to the coast, part of the Whitsunday Great Walk.

name: Mount Rooper Walk
note: Hike: 3.9 km track through Conway National Park to rocky Coral Beach near Mount Rooper.

name: Whitsunday Islands National Park
note: National park: the island park holding the Whitsunday islands' walks and beaches, reached by boat.

name: Lake Proserpine
note: Lake: Peter Faust Dam impoundment known for metre-long barramundi fishing, reached from Proserpine.

name: Big Mango
note: Roadside icon: giant mango sculpture at Bowen that visitors stop to photograph.

name: Queens Beach
note: Beach: sheltered Bowen beach with holiday parks on the waterfront and a short walk from the holiday park.

name: Horseshoe Bay
note: Beach: Bowen beach at the tip of Cape Edgecumbe, surrounded by four sandy beaches.

name: Hydeaway Bay
note: Beach: sandy, still-water bay on the Cape Gloucester coast 45 minutes north of Airlie Beach, with rock pools and whale sightings May to September.

name: Cape Gloucester Lookouts
note: Viewpoint: lookouts on the Cape Gloucester coast over the Gloucester Islands, a whale-watching stop; named by Tourism Whitsundays.

name: Whitsunday Crocodile Safari
note: Wildlife tour: crocodile-watching safari from the mainland, an operator's tour rather than a fixed place; the wildlife encounter is the attraction.

name: Broken River Platypus Viewing
note: Wildlife viewing: platypus spotting at Broken River near Eungella, named by Mackay Isaac Tourism as a photographer's stop.

name: Pioneer Valley
note: Valley: rainforest valley west of Mackay with mountain-bike trails and freshwater swimming holes, named by Mackay Isaac Tourism.

name: Sarina Field of Dreams Parklands
note: Park: parklands in Sarina that house the regional visitor information centre; visitor value not verified beyond the tourism listing.
